notes.title: Update for Switch Pro Build
notes.notes: Fixed how the text is displaying in the Switch Pro build to display the correct button commands in the intro level.

notes.title: Update V2.7
notes.notes: This update fixes some minor issues with the controller detection script and pause scripts to work properly in the game.

notes.title: Update Available
notes.notes:
The update that mentioned weeks ago is now available to download. This took longer than anticipated with the updates, but it was well worth it in the end!

What has been updated?

First, the overall look of the game was updated to make the visuals look impressive. The Switch controls have been updated to work on the Switch Pro Controller only now to provide a better user experience when playing that build. The "How To Play" button has been removed as the intro level teaches you how to play the game now.

The file size was increased with the added sprites, animations, and codes. A new mechanic has been added to The Adventures of Maximus. Now, you can dash your way through the game. However, you do need to unlock this mechanic to use this new ability.

Thank you for your support and have fun playing our game!

notes.title: Updates in the works
notes.notes:
We are working on updating the game for all builds that we hope to push sometime this week. Please, stay tuned as we work on polishing up the game with some new features.

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Look Forward To The New Updates
notes.notes: The update that was mentioned earlier will be available soon. This update has some minor fixes, including another build that has the Nintendo Switch Joy-Con controls! Bluetooth both Joy-Cons to your computer before launching the game. Have fun!

notes.title: Upcoming Update
notes.notes: We are working on another update for the game that will be coming soon. The update will allow you to play the game with your Switch Joy-Cons. We will keep you informed on when the update will be ready. Thank you for playing our game!

notes.title: Update Is Ready
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Today, we have launched the update that was communicated earlier this week. Now, you are able to toggle the power-ups to defeat the bosses quickly. You can also pause the game to select the power-up that you want on, too. Thank you for your patience and have fun playing our game!

Thank you,

Renecade

notes.title: Update Coming Soon
notes.notes:

Thank you for playing our game!

Take care,

Renecade
